set.body: ADR 0027 §4. Model proposer for pronoun and description mentions: dated deepseek-v4.1-flash pin, fallback off, ZDR, content-keyed recordings with offline replay, USD 5 ceiling for the round accounted as reported / accounted upper bound / attempted bound. Inputs: the mention's decoder-segment words and Name-All / Name-Speaking of overlapping and adjacent rows; no scene descriptions. Output: deictic proposal, candidate set, or absent/unclear, with reason. Owner authorized spend 2026-10-24.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3c-4] Recorded model proposals for deixis and descriptions
